name: maket
description: Visual design tool for AI assistants — compose posters, flyers, labels, social posts with PDF export.
long_description:
Maket turns your AI assistant into a visual designer. Describe what you want — a poster, a flyer, a product label — and the AI composes it with precise typography, brand chartes, and your image library.

A live preview opens automatically in your browser and updates in real time as the AI works. Annotate elements directly in the preview to give feedback. Export to PDF when you're done.

tools.name: maket_doc
tools.description: Document lifecycle: new, list, delete, duplicate, rename, meta, export/import (.maket bundle).

tools.name: maket_page
tools.description: Manage pages within a document: add, remove, rename, reorder, list.

tools.name: maket_canvas
tools.description: Set a document's canvas: format, orientation, background, margin.

tools.name: maket_html
tools.description: Read and write page HTML: set (full replace), patch (surgical ops by data-id), get, check (layout overflow).

tools.name: maket_workspace
tools.description: Session-level workspace actions: focus a doc/page in the preview, inspect its state, toggle lock, fit the whole workspace to view, read and acknowledge pending user messages. Actions: focus, state, lock, fit_view, list_messages, ack_messages.

tools.name: maket_charte
tools.description: Manage brand style guides: list, view (returns context_token), set, delete.

tools.name: maket_collection
tools.description: Manage placeholder collections: list, view, create, validate/change schema, edit rows, delete, bind/unbind a document page.

tools.name: maket_state
tools.description: Attach document-owned state, update it with snapshots or JSON Patch, validate/change its schema, inspect history, and restore revisions.

tools.name: maket_learn
tools.description: Agent onboarding and operating guidance for Maket: workflow, HTML composition, chartes, collections, living document state, review, and MCP client installation.

tools.name: maket_image
tools.description: Manage the asset library: list, view, meta (requires context_token), import, delete.

tools.name: maket_preview
tools.description: Open the live preview URL or snapshot a page to PNG.

tools.name: maket_mermaid
tools.description: Render a Mermaid diagram to SVG and inject it into a page.

tools.name: maket_pdf
tools.description: Export the document to PDF via headless Chromium.

tools.name: maket_gmail
tools.description: Gmail integration: connect, search, read, draft.
